scope: Main-only calibration of specified normals extraction via in-memory TriMesh and Autodesk.Max.GlobalInterface; verified live in 3ds Max 2026.3.2

verified_facts.trimesh_access: node.baseObject.mesh returns an in-memory TriMesh for the Editable_Poly baseObject without UI or modPanel; node.mesh returns the evaluated TriMesh in Object Space.
verified_facts.meshop_rnormals: meshop.getFaceRNormals <trimesh> f returns an array of 3 Point3 normal vectors per face, capturing both smoothing groups and specified normals.
verified_facts.memory_cleanup: delete baseTri and delete evalTri properly release the temporary TriMesh objects from memory.
verified_facts.dotnet_globalinterface: dotNetClass 'Autodesk.Max.GlobalInterface' and its .Instance are live and accessible in 3ds Max 2026.3.2.

interpretation: The user-supplied hint is fully confirmed by live execution. The C++ SDK MNNormalSpec table in Editable_Poly is automatically converted to MeshNormalSpec when accessing .mesh in MAXScript, and meshop.getFaceRNormals reads all per-corner normals in Object Space without UI interaction. This unlocks Gate 1 (specified normals base metadata).
